main_text.p: in matrimonium, & accepit: «Is deinde cuius ea uxor fuerat, «fortiter fecit. repetit eadem. «contradicitur, Petitoris intē-tio: Si placet lex, redde: si non placet, redde. Rei defensio: Si, placet lex, non reddo: si non placet lex, nō reddo. Hæc Gellius lib. IX. cap. XVI. Intētio: Hęc mulier mihi pro pręmio debetur. D. Non debetur. Q. An debeatur? R. Quia quod præmium forti uiro lex attri-buit, id ei perpetuò relinqui uoluit, ne incertum & breu præmium esset. F. Attamen indefinitè scripta est: ut quicquid optarim habeam: nec di-[?]stinxit ab ignauo, uel à forti.

page.notes: The guillemets («) at line ends are printed quotation marks and are kept as printed. The running head is partly covered by a mark over the letters "G" and "S"; read as IVRISCONSVLTVS. The word after "di-" is partly obscured by a stain. Right-margin smudges are stains or show-through and are not transcribed. The bottom "m D." is read as a signature mark.
